mapper.insert: insert into `course` (course_name, teacher_id, credit, capacity, selected_count, course_type, dept_id, target_class_id) values (#{courseName}, #{teacherId}, #{credit}, #{capacity}, 0, #{courseType}, #{deptId}, #{targetClassId})
mapper.select: select c.id, c.course_name as courseName, c.teacher_id as teacherId, c.credit, c.capacity, c.selected_count as selectedCount, c.course_type as courseType, c.dept_id as deptId, c.target_class_id as targetClassId, d.dept_name as department, u.real_name as teacherName from `course` c left join `user` u on c.teacher_id = u.id left join department d on c.dept_id = d.id

select id, course_name as courseName, teacher_id as teacherId, credit, capacity, selected_count as selectedCount, course_type as courseType, dept_id as deptId, target_class_id as targetClassId from `course` where id = #{id}

select id, course_name as courseName, teacher_id as teacherId, credit, capacity, selected_count as selectedCount, course_type as courseType, dept_id as deptId, target_class_id as targetClassId from `course` where teacher_id = #{teacherId} order by id
mapper.insert: insert into course_selection (student_id, course_id) select u.id, #{courseId} from `user` u where u.class_id = #{classId} and u.role = 'STUDENT'
